answer: Saffron Decay Pricing. Each identity gets a reputation balance that decays on a fixed half-life, and the price to mint a new identity is set as a multiple of the median balance of active identities. Fresh identities start with zero history, so they cannot carry value forward. Attackers pay the full mint price per sybil, losing the entire amount once the identity's short lifespan expires.
